title: D1 fix round 3: rebase task/T-0154 onto goal/T-0109 and resolve the README.md Pipeline conflict with D2 (T-0121)
spec:
Fix round for T-0154 (branch task/T-0154 at 4501d91, carrying T-0120 cf7ad84, T-0151 bc1d740, T-0154 4501d91). Work in this task's worktree, cut from task/T-0154. The daemon's merge failed with rebase_conflict on README.md: goal/T-0109 now contains T-0121 (1b94384), which added the line "Scouts are capped (2 per goal, 12 turns, $1.00, 600s) and open with a memory recall step; see `.orchestrator/prompts/scout.md`." at the top of the "## Pipeline" section and kept the old state-machine sentence; T-0120 rewrote the state-machine paragraph to describe the [review] thresholds.

Do: `git rebase goal/T-0109` in this worktree; resolve README.md by keeping BOTH: the T-0121 scouts line first, then the T-0120 paragraph (the one describing spec_review_min, direct_merge_max, two_reviews_from, the one-review/two-review merge rules and the [review] table). While there, make that paragraph match the T-0151 rule: the second review for complexity ≥ two_reviews_from runs "on a different model than the executor (a different account when possible)", not "on whichever tier the first one didn't get". Resolve any other conflict the same way (keep both intents; pool.toml: T-0121's tightened scout limits AND T-0120's [review] table). `git rebase --continue` until done; the branch then has the three D1 commits on top of 1b94384. Run `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` (green) and `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh .` from the worktree. No content change other than the conflict resolution and that one sentence. This task's own commit: none needed if the rebase leaves a clean tree; if you edited the README sentence outside a conflict, commit it as a fourth small commit. Finish with: summary, `git log --oneline goal/T-0109..HEAD`, failures-only test output.
acceptance: task branch rebased onto goal/T-0109: `git merge-base --is-ancestor goal/T-0109 HEAD` true and `git log --oneline goal/T-0109..HEAD` shows the D1 commits only
README.md Pipeline section contains the T-0121 scouts line followed by the T-0120 threshold paragraph, with the second-review sentence saying a different model than the executor
pool.toml carries both the tightened scout limits and the [review] table
uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests green; tests-green.sh green; no new dependency; working tree clean

result.summary:
Working tree is clean, no commit needed (the rebase left the D1 commits exactly, no extra edits outside the conflict resolution). No new dependencies. Everything's green.

## Summary

Rebased `task/T-0157` (carrying T-0120, T-0151, T-0154) onto `goal/T-0109` (tip 1b94384, which added T-0121's scout-limit tightening). Only conflict was in README.md's Pipeline section — resolved by keeping the T-0121 scouts line first, followed by T-0120's threshold paragraph, and updated the second-review sentence to match T-0151's actual rule ("a different model than the executor (a different account when possible)" instead of "whichever tier the first one didn't get"). `.orchestrator/pool.toml` auto-merged cleanly, carrying both T-0121's tightened scout limits (12 turns/$1.00/600s) and T-0120's `[review]` table. Working tree is clean after the rebase — no extra commit was needed.

`git log --oneline goal/T-0109..HEAD`:
```
8a82703 planner.md: sync spec-review threshold line with CLAUDE.md (T-0154)
425775e daemon: D1 fix round 1 from opus review T-0150 (T-0151)
2e32566 daemon: review policy driven by pool.toml [review] table (T-0120)
```

Test output (failures-only): none — `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` ran 167 tests, OK. `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh .` exited 0.
result.review: other account, different model; label PR same-family-review
